In this activity, we’ll build a Clean Energy Indicator using a diode, LED, and voltmeter in the EveryCircuit app.
You’ll learn how a diode allows current to flow in only one direction — a key concept for protecting clean energy systems.
This project supports SDG 13: Climate Action by showing how simple electronics help prevent energy loss in solar panels and batteries.
